evidence.explanation: Teaches inscribing a circle with four numbered constructions: in a given triangle (Example 1), three equal circles in an equilateral triangle, in a sector, and in a regular polygon, rhombus or deltoid (kite). Each has a stepwise method; two evaluation questions follow.

evidence.locator: SS1-SRC-af4868d2c026: lines 201-239 (SHA-256 8299e517d9cbc78a46de7dec40a5560a0f00a3157ba3370242bd7fe342608d67), 'Circumcribedcircles' (sic) with evaluation questions 1-2 on lines 233-239
evidence.explanation: Teaches circumscribing a circle on a triangle (equivalently inscribing a triangle in a circle) with a three-step method by bisecting two sides, followed by two evaluation questions.

The row title states the revision aim, and five general evaluation/revision constructions (triangle from perimeter and base angle, from base, height and vertical angle, from perimeter and ratio, a similar triangle of given perimeter, an octagon in a square; three marked WAEC) provide the revision practice. There is no separate worked revision of last term's topics. The scheme does not name those topics and the 1st Term source is not supplied (TD-MISSING-T1), so the revision scope is unverified: open item TD-T2-W01-REVISION-SCOPE.
